name: Nev URL Shortener
description: Free, secure, ad-free URL shortener with link analytics. Shorten the current page in one click. No sign-up.
author: Nevfar

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; img-src 'self' https://nev.lt data:; style-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src https://nev.lt; base-uri 'none'; frame-src 'none'

_execute_action.description: Open the Nev URL Shortener popup

shorten-and-copy.description: Shorten the current page and copy the link
